boundaries.credentialFreeHostPlatform: detectable-emulation-negative Linux x86_64 candidate only; ARM, QEMU/binfmt, and macOS are refused before Docker, but guest-visible evidence cannot prove physical native execution
boundaries.authoritativeNativeReleaseAttestation: fail closed: authoritative native release acceptance requires a trusted hosted/provider cryptographic hardware attestation bound to the sealed source-generation digest and captured sha256 Docker image ID; no supported verifier is configured and CI/guest strings never satisfy this contract
boundaries.continuousLaneAuthority: one long-lived non-dumpable Python broker performs the native preflight, installs parent/name watches before each nofollow open or safe staged creation from the filesystem root, seals one exact source generation, and retains every DATA/BUILD/state/cache/tool/config descriptor and watch plus the sealed source descriptors through source policy, changed selection, Docker build, Docker run, publication, and final revalidation; JavaScript performs no host preparation
boundaries.sealedSourceGeneration: a recursive mutation-watched capture rejects links, special/private/generated entries and unstable metadata, emits a deterministic content/mode/path manifest plus tar into write/grow/shrink/seal-protected memfds, and supplies that same generation to source policy, changed selection, Docker build stdin, and container extraction; live source is never a Docker bind mount
boundaries.descriptorStableDockerSources: the sealed source tar/manifest, lane state, exactly five cache-data leaves, and the empty Docker config are passed to Docker through /proc/<broker-pid>/fd/<n> while the broker retains the matching descriptors and watches through child exit
boundaries.hostPreparationMutationEvidence: the shared watch-before-target primitive rejects unexpected name, identity, owner, mode, link-count, timestamp, content, and metadata events; fixed missing directories are configured under a unique held token and installed with RENAME_NOREPLACE, while failed random allocations are never path-deleted
boundaries.changedSelectionBoundary: native Linux x86_64 preflight and continuous lane acquisition precede selection; the broker resolves held loose/packed refs itself and runs only config-free cat-file/ls-tree plumbing against a broker-owned empty Git directory and the held object database, then compares that base tree to the sealed source manifest without a worktree, index, attributes, filters, hooks, fsmonitor, submodules, or repo config
boundaries.compilerSourceIsolation: each invocation extracts the held sealed tar into a fresh container-private tmpfs compiler tree; no compiler worktree is host-mounted or persisted, while only build outputs and exactly five dependency cache leaves remain warm
boundaries.trustedSourcePolicy: fixed /usr/bin/node under fixed /usr/bin:/bin PATH; no ambient node, dirname, readlink, shell config, or PATH command resolution
boundaries.credentialFreeToolHomes: fresh container-private HOME/XDG/Gradle/Cargo/npm/Android roots; only five cache-data leaves persist
boundaries.hostDockerBoundary: held root-owned Docker executable, positive environment allowlist, fresh watched descriptor-held empty DOCKER_CONFIG, literal unix:///var/run/docker.sock, and no ambient context/TLS/config redirect; failed random config tokens are not path-deleted
boundaries.debugStorePublication: compiler bytes are copied to held O_TMPFILE destinations, fsynced and destination-hashed before linkat; readers watch before inventory and retain an exact single-link VerifiedSet; selections and retirements share a flock-serialized segmented variable-length logical-sequence/predecessor-digest journal with three reconciled immutable local fact sets, no wall-clock ordering or fixed record cap, and publication never overwrites, renames over, unlinks, or removes a pathname; same-UID offline deletion of all local facts is not cryptographically rollback-resistant and cannot be authoritative release evidence without an external trusted high-water attestation
boundaries.releaseDependencyFetch: networked dependency-only prefetch with no signing or private-asset mounts
boundaries.releaseSigningInputs: external read-only d8a64 mounts validated against fixed certificate identity
boundaries.releaseSigningNetwork: none; Gradle and Cargo run offline from the prefetch cache
